name: How should I prepare my garage before the trim installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my garage before the trim installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for garage trim installation, clear at least six to eight feet of workspace around your garage door openings and interior walls. Move parked vehicles out onto the driveway or street to give the crew unobstructed access to power outlets, exterior jambs, and interior surfaces. Clear away bikes, tools, storage bins, and hoses stored near the doorway edges. Letting your contractor know about existing problems—such as water pooling near the garage apron or sticking garage door tracks—helps them plan proper clearances during installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Park vehicles outside and clear items within six to eight feet of the garage doors and walls so the installation crew has clear access to work and set up tools safely.
